sources.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Tech Blog: Advancing Open Intelligence
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies K3.1 Pro as a post-trained K3 model and describes it as 3T-class, supporting nominal count and architecture inference from K3's primary specifications. Announces hosted availability with full weights due by November 4, 2026; no separate Pro tensor census is provided.

sources.title: Kimi Code: What's New
sources.evidence: The dated model-release entry states that the K3.1 Pro series is live on October 23, 2026.

sources.title: Kimi Code: Model Configuration
sources.evidence: The comparison table separately identifies K3.1 Pro, Pro Highspeed and original K3. The Pro column gives a 1048576-token maximum context, image/video inputs, required thinking, and only 3T-class size; the 2.8T figure belongs to K3. Its technical-report link points to the Pro launch blog.

sources.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro API Quickstart
sources.evidence: Documents exact API ID kimi-k3.1-pro with text, image and video requests, textual answers, mandatory thinking at low/high/max effort, and function/tool-call workflows.

sources.title: Terms of Service for Kimi OpenPlatform
sources.evidence: Section 1 grants limited, nonexclusive access to the API services and reserves the service rights to Moonshot AI, supporting a proprietary hosted-service classification.

sources.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence, version 1
sources.evidence: Original K3 report dated July 27, 2026. Table 1 labels K3 as MoE with 2.78T total and 104.2B activated parameters and hybrid KDA-MLA attention. These values explain the rounded 2.8T/104B nominal card figures used through Pro's documented lineage.

sources.title: Kimi-K3 model card
sources.evidence: The official K3 card supplies nominal 2.8T total and 104B activated counts and MoE architecture with KDA, Gated MLA and Attention Residuals. Combined with Moonshot's explicit Pro post-training lineage, these are the primary basis for Pro's nominal inherited counts.

sources.title: Moonshot AI Hugging Face model inventory filtered to K3
sources.evidence: Direct HTTP 200 response during this audit returned only moonshotai/Kimi-K3; no Pro checkpoint or config was listed. This is a bounded inventory check, corroborating the future weight-release statement rather than proving absence everywhere.

sources.title: Kimi Research Blog index
sources.evidence: The research index dates the Pro blog October 24, 2026. The earlier explicitly dated October 23 Kimi Code release entry establishes public availability before that blog-index date.

sources.title: Models.dev Kimi K3.1 Pro record
sources.evidence: The frozen record's upstream lead links to the Pro launch/API documentation and explicitly distinguishes hosted launch from the future weight release. Its claims were checked against primary documentation.

sources.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro launches at 4th on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
sources.evidence: October 23, 2026 launch analysis directly lists K3.1 Pro at 2.8T total and 104B active. This is secondary corroboration of nominal specifications, not a Moonshot disclosure or independent tensor census.

name.note: Exact developer product name and API variant.

developer.note: Developer-owned announcement and API platform identify Moonshot AI.

family.note: Retain the catalog's broad K3-generation grouping: the developer calls Pro a post-trained K3 and the first member of the K3.1 series.

release_date.note: Explicit dated Kimi Code launch entry confirms October 23 public availability; the October 24 research-index date is later. Weight release is a separate event.

open_weights.note: At the October 27 audit, the primary announcement still schedules full weights by November 4; the official K3 inventory lists only the predecessor. Future open-weight intent does not establish current downloadable Pro weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of current hosted API access under Moonshot's service terms. A future Pro weight license is not established; do not transfer the predecessor's Kimi K3 License.

parameters_b.note: Nominal 2800B (2.8T), inferred from Moonshot's explicit identification of Pro as post-trained K3 and K3's official card. K3's report gives 2.78T at finer precision; this record retains the rounded nominal convention, not an exact Pro tensor census. Artificial Analysis independently lists the same nominal Pro size.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 104B activated per token, inferred from the explicit post-trained-K3 lineage and official K3 card, with secondary Pro-specific corroboration from Artificial Analysis. K3's finer 104.2B report value is not asserted as an exact Pro count. No storage elements, quantization scales or buffers are counted.

architecture.note: Architecture classification follows the developer's explicit identification of K3.1 Pro as a post-trained K3 model, combined with K3's documented MoE architecture. This is a lineage-based derivation, not a Pro checkpoint/config inspection; exact tensor dimensions and parameter counts are not independently confirmed.

context_window.note: Exact maximum in the Pro model column; lower membership entitlements do not reduce the model's documented maximum.

modalities.note: Exact Pro API examples accept text, image and video and return textual message content.

reasoning.note: Thinking is explicitly required, with low/high/max reasoning effort and separate reasoning_content output.

tool_call.note: Pro quickstart documents tools definitions, returned tool_calls, execution and subsequent tool messages.

description.value: Multimodal Kimi model with 1M context and always-on reasoning for coding, 3D creation, financial research, and agentic work
description.note: Supported summary of documented modalities, context, reasoning behavior and intended task domains; no comparative benchmark claim is added.

sources.label: Kimi K3 technical report, architecture and Table 1
Secondary corroboration: Artificial Analysis Pro launch

patch.notes: The 2.8T total and 104B active figures are nominal lineage-based inferences from Moonshot's explicit description of Pro as post-trained K3 and the official K3 model card; Artificial Analysis corroborates these Pro specifications. They are not a separate Pro tensor census. K3's finer report values of 2.78T/104.2B are not asserted as exact Pro counts. Moonshot calls Pro 3T-class, not exactly 3000B. MoE architecture follows the same documented K3 lineage. As of October 27, 2026, hosted access is proprietary and full weights are scheduled by November 4; the future weight license is not established.

summary: Confirmed the October 23 hosted launch and API capabilities. Records MoE architecture and nominal 2800B total/104B active counts derived from Moonshot's explicit post-trained-K3 relationship and the official K3 card, with secondary count corroboration from Artificial Analysis. No separate Pro tensor census or component breakdown is claimed. Current hosted-service license is proprietary, and open weights remain false pending the announced November release.
